description: List available TeamSpeak plan-change options and constraints for a service. Use preview_teamspeak_plan_change for the full change overview with pricing before applying.

serviceId.description: ID of the TeamSpeak server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_teamspeak_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.
